jobs.prompt:
Asset type: production-ready 2D decorative material for a real desktop UI. Match the supplied approved references: finely chased antique gold/brass, dark walnut-brown leather, warm ivory and dark sepia hatching. Extremely fine engraved detail, dignified scholarly sword-and-magic grimoire craftsmanship. This is only an asset, never a UI screenshot. Absolutely NO text, letters, labels, logos, buttons, numbers, scientific axes or curves. No green/purple/burgundy variants, silver or neon. No perspective or lighting cast onto an external scene. Preserve the common gold/brown palette. Keep all ornament fully inside the canvas with a clear safety margin.
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE seamless square dark-walnut leather texture tile, 1024x1024 if possible. Natural fine leather grain, very subtle blind-embossed acanthus curls and small etched star/compass marks at low contrast, even lighting, quiet near-solid reading surface. No frame, no edge vignette, no central medallion, no visible seam. Delicate fine tooling, never bright enough to compete with gold UI text; richer than flat brown or random diagonal scratches. Entire image is opaque walnut leather, meant to tile under readable menus and toolbar controls.

Use case: background-extraction / illustration-story. Create ONE complete rectangular grimoire PERIMETER FRAME ONLY on a truly transparent RGBA canvas, landscape4:3 about1448x1086. Four rounded sculpted baroque acanthus gold corner mounts, thin continuous double beaded antique-gold rules, a narrow dark walnut leather strip within the perimeter. No central crest in this image: the crest will be a separate overlay. The entire very large inner opening must be alpha zero, with no paper or brown background inside. Outer corner caps may be about8% of width and10% of height, beautifully engraved; straight edge strips are only2-3% of width/height. The frame must be uninterrupted on all four sides and have comfortably rounded corners. Richer acanthus carving than a plain thin metallic rectangle. True transparency outside the rounded corners and throughout inner opening. No drop shadow extending across the centre.
